items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Right. Yeah. Nelson Riddle did the Ronstadt record.

ctx.x: record. There was a thing that he did that made Nelson a brilliant record maker and brilliant arranger. Now I had no idea that when I played my arrangements I had people that recognized that I did Charlie Calello, that recognized that -- I didn’t know that I had a sound but there were other people that identified the sound. So now if you have that consistency it’s very, very difficult to then come out of that box and suddenly try to make a twist. Now I didn’t know I was really doing that when I went through the…

I had a quote from you from our conversation a year ago on the phone, you said, “We never got out of the sound box.” But I can’t remember what the context was. I think you’re talking about that. And were you referring to – Linda Ronstadt did a –
Right. Yeah. Nelson Riddle did the Ronstadt record.
